sources.title: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 · Models - modelscope.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 Enhances Character Consistency In Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, character consistency has been significantly improved. The model can perform imaginative edits based on an input portrait while preserving the identity and visual characteristics of the subject.

sources.title: Qwen-Image-Edit-Series · Models
sources.snippet: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 is an image editing diffusion model distilled from Alibaba Qwen team's image editing model. It can edit input images according to text instructions and supports multi-reference image inputs.
